about.title: Senior, in practice
bio: I started in 2021 building React Native apps at Khomp while still in college. Between TDBUSINESS and freelance work, I spent four years shipping platforms for Sebrae, the Brazilian Space Agency, Sindipi and Fapesc — multi-tenant CRMs, analytics dashboards, chatbots and infrastructure automation.

Today, as a Senior AI Engineer at Cadmus, I work where product, AI and security meet: agents that touch real codebases, multi-tenant RAG, and the governance that lets all of it run in production without surprises. Outside work, I build and run my own products — Elencar, Patiê and Hades — on a VPS I manage myself.
